roll

  • CURIE: gmeow:roll
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/roll
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

Rotation about the longitudinal (typically x) axis, in degrees or radians as indicated by the reference frame.

Structure

Property shape: datatype property; gmeow:Orientation -> xsd:double

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:roll from gmeow:Orientation to xsd:double when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use for rotation about the longitudinal axis in the Euler-angle facet.

Avoid when

  • Avoid Euler angles without gmeow:eulerOrder.

How to use

  • Set gmeow:roll with gmeow:yaw, gmeow:pitch, and gmeow:eulerOrder.

Examples

  • ex:ori gmeow:roll 0.0; gmeow:eulerOrder "ZYX".
